# Differential Expression Analysis -- COMPUTE STEP

#===================================================================
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
#===================================================================
# This is the CRITICAL COMPUTE step: builds the spatial group
# definitions (InvadedNerve/Nerve/TumorProximal/TumorDistal), runs the
# pseudo-bulk limma differential expression for all 4 contrasts used
# throughout the manuscript, and produces DE_SPE_annotaion.csv -- the
# file every other script in this project reads as its colData source.
#
# NOTE ON RE-RUNNING: TumorDistalID (like NerveID in
# 03_nerve_identification) is assigned via hclust/cutree -- in
# principle deterministic, but not guaranteed identical across R/package
# versions. Since this feeds directly into which spots get pooled into
# which pseudo-bulk sample for the DE tests below, re-running this from
# scratch could in principle shift pseudo-bulk group membership at the
# margins. Treat the outputs here (DE_analysis_results.rds,
# DE_SPE_annotaion.csv) as a frozen result once generated -- see
# 04_DE_analysis_figures_cleaned.Rmd for regenerating figures without
# re-running any of this.
#
# BUGFIXES (this pass):
#   - The same contrast/result variable names (conInvadedNerve, conRec,
#     res, confit, defint, out) were reused for 4 DIFFERENT contrasts in
#     sequence -- same class of naming collision fixed elsewhere in this
#     project. Renamed to be contrast-specific throughout.
#   - write.csv(DE_SPE_annotaion.csv) was missing row.names=FALSE.
#
# Handoff (input/):
#   - DE_SPE_annotaion.csv
#       *** THE FILE every downstream script in this project reads. ***
#
# Processed (processed/):
#   - DE_analysis_results.rds
#       Bundle of everything the figures script needs: topSen (Invaded
#       vs NonInvaded), compNerve + defint_invaded (two-contrast
#       invaded-nerve prioritization), topRec (TumorProximal vs
#       TumorDistal), compRec + defint_tumorprox (two-contrast tumour-
#       proximity prioritization), corr_invaded_genes_df (Spearman
#       correlations), plus sb/sub (pseudo-bulk + spot-level objects
#       needed for the heatmaps).
#
# Tables (output/04_DE_analysis/tables/):
#   - <sample_id>_annotation.csv (x6)
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(limma)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(batchelor)
library(scran)
library(scater)
library(ggspavis)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=14))

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")
SCRIPTS_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "scripts")

NERVE_ID_TABLES_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", "03_nerve_identification", "tables")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "04_DE_analysis"
TABLES_DIR    <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "tables")
dir.create(PROCESSED_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(TABLES_DIR,    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source(file.path(SCRIPTS_DIR, "general_functions.R"))

minmaxscale <- function(x, ...) (x - min(x, ...)) / (max(x, ...) - min(x, ...))

spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(NERVE_ID_TABLES_DIR, "nerveID.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode
```

#Definition of groups
```{r}
cmp <- t(reducedDim(spe,"compk30"))
nervmx <- names(which(apply(cmp,2,which.max)==(which(rownames(cmp)=="Nerve"))))
def <- spe$Invaded=="Invaded"
def[is.na(def)] <- FALSE
invadedNerveCells <- spe$barcode[def]
names(invadedNerveCells) <- rep("InvadedNerve",length(invadedNerveCells))
spe$InvadedNerve <- def

def <- spe$Invaded=="NonInvaded"
def[is.na(def)] <- FALSE
nerveCells <- spe$barcode[def]
names(nerveCells) <- rep("Nerve",length(nerveCells))
spe$Nerve <- def
```

```{r}
tummx <- names(which(apply(cmp,2,which.max)==(which(rownames(cmp)=="Ductal_malignant"))))
def <- spe$BorderInvaded=="Invaded" & spe$barcode %in% tummx
def[is.na(def)] <- FALSE
tumorProximalCells <- spe$barcode[def]
names(tumorProximalCells) <- rep("TumorProximal",length(tumorProximalCells))
spe$tumorProximalCells <- def
```

```{r}
def <- is.na(spe$BorderID) & spe$barcode %in% tummx & !spe$NerveProximal & !spe$is.nerve
def[is.na(def)] <- FALSE
spe$TumorDistal <- def

sub <- spe[,spe$TumorDistal]
pos <- cbind(sub$row,sub$col)
nn <- BayesSpace:::find_neighbors(pos,radius=2,method="manhattan")
dd <- dist(pos,method="manhattan")
tree <- hclust(dd,method="single")
sub$TumorDistalID <- cutree(tree,h=2)

add <- data.frame(colData(sub)[,c("barcode","TumorDistalID")])
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(dplyr::left_join(data.frame(colData(spe)),add))
setna <- as.integer(names(which(table(spe$TumorDistalID)<4)))
spe$TumorDistalID[spe$TumorDistalID %in% setna] <- NA
spe$TumorDistal[is.na(spe$TumorDistalID)] <- FALSE
tumorDistalCells <- spe$barcode[spe$TumorDistal]
names(tumorDistalCells) <- rep("TumorDistal",length(tumorDistalCells))
```

```{r}
sample_key <- data.frame(
  sample_id = c(
    "54703bl38_noPNI", "54703bl28_highPNI",
    "6249bl23_noPNI", "6249bl18_noPNIandhighPNI",
    "70865bl5_noPNI", "70865bl15_highPNI"
  ),
  patient = c("Patient 1","Patient 1","Patient 2","Patient 2","Patient 3","Patient 3"),
  context = c("Adjacent","Diseased","Adjacent","Diseased","Adjacent","Diseased"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
spe$patient <- sample_key$patient[match(spe$sample_id, sample_key$sample_id)]
spe$context <- sample_key$context[match(spe$sample_id, sample_key$sample_id)]
spe$patient <- factor(spe$patient, levels = c("Patient 1","Patient 2","Patient 3"))
spe$context <- factor(spe$context, levels = c("Adjacent","Diseased"))

frm <- c(invadedNerveCells, nerveCells, tumorProximalCells, tumorDistalCells)
tpe <- plyr::mapvalues(spe$barcode, from = frm, to = names(frm))
tpe[!spe$barcode %in% unname(frm)] <- NA
spe$Area <- tpe
spe$Area[is.na(spe$Area)] <- "other"
```

```{r}
smps <- unique(spe$sample_id)
for (smp in smps) {
  expr <- data.frame(colData(spe)[spe$sample_id==smp,])
  keep <- c("barcode","Area","is.nerve","k30label","Invaded")
  expr <- expr[,keep]
  expr$barcode <- gsub(paste0(smp,"_"),"",expr$barcode)
  write.csv(expr, file.path(TABLES_DIR, paste0(smp,"_annotation.csv")), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
}
```

# Identifying surrounding spots
```{r}
getContacts <- function(input,rad,knn,query=rownames(input),graph=FALSE,x="pxl_col_in_fullres",y="pxl_row_in_fullres") {
    require(RANN); require(Matrix); require(igraph)
    query.data <- input[query,c(x,y)]
    nn <- nn2(data=input[,c(x,y)],query=query.data,k=knn,radius=rad,searchtype="radius")
    nn.ct <- apply(nn[["nn.idx"]], 1, function(ROW) {
        tmp <- sapply(ROW,function(ELEMENT) { out <- NA; if(ELEMENT!=0) out <- input$Cluster[ELEMENT]; out })
        return(unlist(tmp))
    })
    expected <- unique(input$Cluster)
    out.list <- lapply(1:ncol(nn.ct),function(COL) {
        contacts <- nn.ct[,COL]; contacts <- contacts[-1]
        freq <- as.data.frame(table("Contact_Celltype"=contacts))
        mssng <- setdiff(expected,freq$Contact_Celltype)
        if (length(mssng)>0) freq <- rbind(freq, data.frame("Contact_Celltype"=mssng,"Freq"=rep(0,length(mssng))))
        freq$barcode <- input[query,"barcode"][COL]
        freq$Cluster <- input[query,"Cluster"][COL]
        return(freq)
    })
    do.call(rbind,out.list)
}

# NOTE: this broad ring was exploratory. The `invasion` column it creates
# is used only by figures that are NOT in the manuscript, and every figure
# script reads the frozen DE_SPE_annotaion.csv rather than recomputing it,
# so the deposited annotation file -- not this radius -- is authoritative.
out_border <- list()
nneighbors <- 10
rd <- nneighbors * 23
kn <- (nneighbors * 6) + 1
input <- data.frame(spatialCoords(spe))
input$barcode <- spe$barcode
input$Cluster <- spe$NerveID
input$sample_id <- spe$sample_id

for (smp in unique(input$sample_id)) {
  inp <- input[input$sample_id == smp,]
  cons <- getContacts(input=inp,rad=rd,knn=kn)
  cons <- cons[is.na(cons$Cluster) & !is.na(cons$Contact_Celltype),]
  cons <- cons[cons$Freq>0,]
  cons <- cons[!duplicated(cons$barcode),]
  out_border[[smp]] <- data.frame("barcode"=cons$barcode,"BorderID"=cons$Contact_Celltype,"sample_id"=smp)
}
add2 <- Reduce(rbind,out_border)

add2$invasion <- plyr::mapvalues(add2$BorderID, from = spe$NerveID, to=spe$Invaded, warn_missing = FALSE)
add2$invasion <- as.character(add2$invasion)
add2$barcode <- as.character(add2$barcode)
add2$invasion[add2$invasion == "Invaded"] <- "Surr_Invaded"
add2$invasion[add2$invasion == "NonInvaded"] <- "Surr_NonInvaded"

spe$invasion   <- as.character(spe$Area)
spe$invasionID <- NA_character_      # must exist before subassignment
j   <- match(spe$barcode, add2$barcode)
hit <- !is.na(j)
spe$invasion[hit]   <- as.character(add2$invasion[j[hit]])
spe$invasionID[hit] <- as.character(add2$BorderID[j[hit]])
```

#Run DE (pseudo-bulk + limma, patient as random effect)
```{r}
sub <- spe[,spe$Area %in% c("InvadedNerve","TumorProximal","Nerve","TumorDistal")]
sub$ID <- sub$NerveID
sub$ID[is.na(sub$ID)] <- sub$BorderID[is.na(sub$ID)]
sub$ID[is.na(sub$ID)] <- sub$TumorDistalID[is.na(sub$ID)] + 1000

ids <- DataFrame(area=sub$Area, sample_id=sub$sample_id, id=sub$ID)
sb <- aggregateAcrossCells(sub,ids)

levs <- paste(colData(sb)$area, colData(sb)$id, colData(sb)$sample_id, sep = ".")
colData(sb)$level_id <- levs
colnames(sb) <- levs

sb <- sb[,sb$ncells > 1 & sb$ncells < 100]
sb <- computeLibraryFactors(sb)
sb <- logNormCounts(sb)

mdl <- model.matrix(~ 0 + area,data.frame(colData(sb)))
keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(logcounts(sb), design=mdl, min.count=2)
sb <- sb[keep,]
m <- logcounts(sb)

corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(m, mdl, block = colData(sb)$sample_id)
cat("Consensus correlation:", corfit$consensus.correlation, "\n")

fit <- lmFit(m, design = mdl, block = colData(sb)$sample_id, correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation)
```

**Contrast 1: Invaded Nerves vs Non-Invaded Nerves**
```{r}
contrast_invaded_vs_noninvaded <- makeContrasts("areaInvadedNerve-areaNerve", levels=colnames(mdl))
fit_invaded_vs_noninvaded <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrast_invaded_vs_noninvaded))

topSen <- topTable(fit_invaded_vs_noninvaded, n=nrow(fit_invaded_vs_noninvaded))
topSen$Gene <- rownames(topSen)
topSen$FDR <- topSen$adj.P.Val
```

**Contrast 2 (control): Tumor Distal vs Non-Invaded Nerves -- used to prioritize invaded-nerve-specific genes**
```{r}
contrast_tumordistal_vs_noninvaded <- makeContrasts("areaTumorDistal-areaNerve", levels=colnames(mdl))
fit_tumordistal_vs_noninvaded <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrast_tumordistal_vs_noninvaded))

topRS <- topTable(fit_tumordistal_vs_noninvaded, n=nrow(fit_tumordistal_vs_noninvaded))
topRS$Gene <- rownames(topRS)
topRS$FDR <- topRS$adj.P.Val

compNerve <- topSen
colnames(compNerve) <- paste0("InvadedNerve",".",colnames(compNerve))
topRS <- topRS[rownames(topSen),]
compNerve$Rec.logFC <- topRS$logFC
compNerve$Rec.adj.P.Val <- topRS$adj.P.Val

compNerve$InvadedNerveSignificance <- compNerve$InvadedNerve.adj.P.Val < 0.1 & abs(compNerve$InvadedNerve.logFC)
compNerve$RecSignificance <- compNerve$Rec.adj.P.Val < 0.1 & abs(compNerve$Rec.logFC)
compNerve$Significance <- ifelse(compNerve$InvadedNerveSignificance & compNerve$RecSignificance, "SigInBoth",
  ifelse(compNerve$InvadedNerveSignificance & !compNerve$RecSignificance, "SigInInvaded",
  ifelse(!compNerve$InvadedNerveSignificance & compNerve$RecSignificance, "SigInTumor", "UnSig")))

defint_invaded <- compNerve$Significance=="SigInInvaded" & compNerve$InvadedNerve.logFC > 0
defint_invaded <- defint_invaded | (((compNerve$InvadedNerve.logFC > 0) & (compNerve$Rec.logFC < 0)) & compNerve$Significance=="SigInBoth")
defint_invaded <- defint_invaded | (((compNerve$InvadedNerve.logFC - compNerve$Rec.logFC > 0.5)) & compNerve$Significance=="SigInBoth" & compNerve$InvadedNerve.logFC > 0)

cat("Invaded-nerve-specific gene set:", sum(defint_invaded), "genes\n")
```

**Correlation of invaded-nerve-specific genes with Tumor/Nerve NMF, within invaded-nerve spots**
```{r}
feats_invaded <- rownames(compNerve[defint_invaded,])
sub2 <- spe[,!is.na(spe$Invaded)]
sub2 <- sub2[,sub2$Invaded=="Invaded" & !is.na(sub2$NerveID)]
tm <- reducedDim(sub2,"compk30")[,"Ductal_malignant"]
nrv <- reducedDim(sub2,"compk30")[,"Nerve"]
m_sub2 <- logcounts(sub2)[feats_invaded,]

corr_invaded_genes_df <- data.frame()
for (gene in feats_invaded){
  cornrv <- cor.test(nrv,m_sub2[gene,], alternative='greater', method="spearman")
  cortm <- cor.test(tm,m_sub2[gene,], alternative='greater', method="spearman")
  corr_invaded_genes_df <- rbind(corr_invaded_genes_df, data.frame(
    "Gene"= gene, "TumorCor" = cortm$estimate, "NerveCor" = cornrv$estimate,
    "TumorPval" = cortm$p.value, "NervePval" = cornrv$p.value
  ))
}
corr_invaded_genes_df$TumorPval <- p.adjust(corr_invaded_genes_df$TumorPval, method="BH")
corr_invaded_genes_df$NervePval <- p.adjust(corr_invaded_genes_df$NervePval, method="BH")
corr_invaded_genes_df$Group <- ifelse(corr_invaded_genes_df$TumorPval < 0.01 & corr_invaded_genes_df$NervePval < 0.01,
  "Both", ifelse(corr_invaded_genes_df$TumorPval < 0.01, "Tumor", ifelse(corr_invaded_genes_df$NervePval < 0.01, "Nerve", "None")))
```

**Contrast 3: Tumor Proximal vs Tumor Distal**
```{r}
contrast_tumorprox_vs_tumordistal <- makeContrasts("areaTumorProximal-areaTumorDistal",levels=colnames(mdl))
fit_tumorprox_vs_tumordistal <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrast_tumorprox_vs_tumordistal))

topRec <- topTable(fit_tumorprox_vs_tumordistal,n=nrow(fit_tumorprox_vs_tumordistal))
topRec$Gene <- rownames(topRec)
topRec$FDR <- topRec$adj.P.Val
```

**Contrast 4 (control): Nerve vs Tumor Distal -- used to prioritize tumor-proximity-specific genes**
```{r}
contrast_nerve_vs_tumordistal <- makeContrasts("areaNerve-areaTumorDistal",levels=colnames(mdl))
fit_nerve_vs_tumordistal <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrast_nerve_vs_tumordistal))

topSR <- topTable(fit_nerve_vs_tumordistal,n=nrow(fit_nerve_vs_tumordistal))
topSR$Gene <- rownames(topSR)
topSR$FDR <- topSR$adj.P.Val

compRec <- topRec
colnames(compRec) <- paste0("InvadedNerve",".",colnames(compRec))
topSR <- topSR[rownames(topRec),]
compRec$Rec.logFC <- topSR$logFC
compRec$Rec.adj.P.Val <- topSR$adj.P.Val

compRec$InvadedNerveSignificance <- compRec$InvadedNerve.adj.P.Val < 0.1
compRec$RecSignificance <- compRec$Rec.adj.P.Val < 0.1
compRec$Significance <- ifelse(compRec$InvadedNerveSignificance & compRec$RecSignificance, "SigInBoth",
  ifelse(compRec$InvadedNerveSignificance & !compRec$RecSignificance, "SigInInvaded",
  ifelse(!compRec$InvadedNerveSignificance & compRec$RecSignificance, "SigInTumor", "UnSig")))

defint_tumorprox <- compRec$Significance=="SigInInvaded" & compRec$InvadedNerve.logFC > 0
defint_tumorprox <- defint_tumorprox | (((compRec$InvadedNerve.logFC > 0) & (compRec$Rec.logFC < 0)) & compRec$Significance=="SigInBoth")

cat("Tumor-proximity-specific gene set:", sum(defint_tumorprox), "genes\n")
```

# CRITICAL HANDOFF: see header note.
DE_ANNOTATION_PATH <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")
write.csv(data.frame(colData(spe)), DE_ANNOTATION_PATH, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved:", DE_ANNOTATION_PATH, "\n")

DE_results_bundle <- list(
  topSen = topSen,
  compNerve = compNerve, defint_invaded = defint_invaded,
  corr_invaded_genes_df = corr_invaded_genes_df,
  topRec = topRec,
  compRec = compRec, defint_tumorprox = defint_tumorprox,
  sb = sb, sub = sub
)
saveRDS(DE_results_bundle, file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "DE_analysis_results.rds"))
cat("Saved:", file.path(PROCESSED_DIR, "DE_analysis_results.rds"), "\n")
